about.title: About Us
about.description: Meet Paul Mitchell, Jacob Thompson Fisher, Chris Chaffee, and Liz Stitt—the people behind RP Data.

sections.title:
People who see
the bigger picture.
sections.body: RP Data brings the data and analysis work of Redistricting Partners together with related projects, public tools, and a team that understands communities.

items.title: Paul Mitchell
items.subtitle: Leadership · Data & analysis
items.body:
Paul leads RP Data. He is the owner of Redistricting Partners and Vice President of Political Data, bringing experience in demographics, redistricting, polling, and survey research. His work spans states, cities, counties, school boards, and community college districts, as well as nonprofit organizations working on elections and community engagement.

Paul holds a Master of Public Policy from the University of Southern California, an undergraduate degree from American University, and an associate degree from Orange Coast College.

items.title: Jacob Thompson Fisher
items.subtitle: Data · Mapping
items.body:
Jacob is part of the RP Data team and contributes to the mapping work of Redistricting Partners. His published projects include interactive district maps for the City of Napa and San Juan Water District, helping people explore proposed boundaries and compare different plans.

His work connects geographic information with tools that make district maps easier to use and share.

items.title: Chris Chaffee
items.subtitle: Outreach · Strategy
items.body:
Chris brings more than two decades of experience in policy, data management, campaigns, and community outreach. As a former Chief Operating Officer of Redistricting Partners, he helped guide local agencies through the 2020 redistricting cycle.

His experience includes developing systems that organize outreach, track engagement, and help organizations use data to make decisions. He brings that practical connection between information and community participation to the team.

items.title: Liz Stitt
items.subtitle: Public policy · Redistricting
items.body:
Elizabeth “Liz” Stitt is the Administrative Program Coordinator at the University of Texas at Austin’s Center for Law and Democracy. Previously, she served as Chief Administrative Officer and Senior Line Drawer at Redistricting Partners, leading municipal redistricting projects and helping draw California’s 2025 congressional districts.

Liz has also worked in the California and Texas legislatures. She earned a Master in Public Affairs from UT Austin’s LBJ School and bachelor’s degrees in international relations and political science from UC Davis.

what-we-do.title: What We Do
what-we-do.description: Census data consulting, Census outreach, GIS and mapping, data analysis, and the My District lookup tool.

sections.title:
Make information
work for you.
sections.body: Understand a population. Plan your outreach. Put a question on a map. We bring research and practical tools to the work you need to do.

items.title: Census Data Consulting
items.subtitle: Understand the people behind the numbers.
items.body:
Make Census data useful for your organization. We help agencies and community partners understand population, demographic change, and the geographic patterns that shape their work.

  • Population and demographic profiles
  • Census and American Community Survey data
  • Research, interpretation, and clear reporting

items.title: Census Outreach
items.subtitle: Reach the communities that need to be counted.
items.body:
Turn demographic research into an outreach plan. We help identify communities that may be missed, organize geographic priorities, and give local partners information they can use.

  • Community and audience mapping
  • Outreach planning and partner support
  • Tools to organize and evaluate engagement

items.title: GIS Services / Mapping
items.subtitle: Put your information in context.
items.body:
From boundary files to maps residents can use, we connect data to place. We create geographic analysis and maps that make complex information easier to explore and explain.

  • District and service-area mapping
  • Geographic data preparation and analysis
  • Interactive web maps and presentation maps

items.title: Data Analysis
items.subtitle: Move from a spreadsheet to an answer.
items.body:
Bring a dataset, a research question, or a decision you need to make. We help organize the information, examine the patterns, and communicate what the results mean.

  • Data cleaning, integration, and review
  • Demographic, survey, and geographic analysis
  • Visualizations, reports, and decision support

items.title: My District
items.subtitle: Connect residents with their representatives.
items.body:
An address lookup built for cities, counties, school districts, community colleges, and special districts. Residents find their district and elected officials; your team keeps the information current.

  • Four layouts with agency branding
  • A hosted page or an embedded lookup
  • Editable officials, photos, biographies, and contacts

my-district.title: My District
my-district.description: A public address lookup that connects residents with their districts and elected officials. Four layouts, your branding, and editable agency information.

sections.eyebrow: My District · A tool from RP Data
sections.title:
Your community.
A clearer connection.
sections.body: A simple question deserves a clear answer: who represents me? Give residents an address lookup that puts their district, their elected officials, and useful contact information in one place.

items.title: Start with an address
items.body: Find a district, see a location on the map, and connect with the representatives who serve that area.

items.title: Fit your website
items.body: Use a page hosted by RP Data or embed the lookup on your existing website. Choose a layout and add your agency branding.

items.title: Keep it current
items.body: Your agency can update names, photos, biographies, dates, and contact information through a protected administration workspace.

sections.title:
Your information.
Your preferred layout.
sections.body: All four designs use the same agency information. Publish an update once and it appears across the layouts.

items.title: Classic
items.body: Address search, representative information, and a map together in a familiar layout.
